{{Navbar-Global_Coal_Plant_Tracker}}
'''Yuguang Coal power station''' (山西国际能源裕光煤电盂县电厂) is an operating power station of at least 2000-megawatts (MW) in Niucun Town, Yu, Yangquan, Shanxi, China.

==Background on Project==

Gemeng International has proposed 2 × 1000MW ultra-supercritical coal-fired generating units for Yu County. The power station is planned for operation in 2017.<ref>[http://www.csepdi.com/news/infos/2773.html "我院签订山西国际能源裕光煤电有限责任公司盂县2×1000MW超超临界燃煤发电机组工程勘察设计合同,"] CCDC, 2014-10-11</ref> 

The EIA was submitted in 2015.<ref>[http://www.sxyx.gov.cn/sy/xwzx/tzgg/516688.shtml "山西国际能源集团有限公司盂县电厂2×100万千瓦项目第二次环境影响评价信息公示,"] Shanxi Province, June 15, 2015</ref><ref>[http://www.yuxiancity.com/detail/detail.asp?/42815.htm "山西国际能源裕光煤电有限责任公司盂县电厂2×100万千瓦发电机组,"] Yuxian City, 11-25-2016</ref> 

The power station was permitted for construction in August 2017.<ref>[http://www.mep.gov.cn/gkml/hbb/spwj1/201708/t20170831_420704.htm "关于山西国际能源裕光煤电有限责任公司盂县电厂2×100万千瓦项目环境影响报告书的批复,"] China MEP, 2017</ref>

Construction began in October 2017.<ref>[http://news.bjx.com.cn/html/20171012/854807.shtml "盂县电厂2×100万千瓦发电项目1号间冷塔工程破土动工,"] 北极星电力网新闻中心, 2017/10/12</ref> The Shanxi Provincial Development and Reform Commission considers the power station one of its "eight key projects of 2018". It is planned to support a UHV power transmission line from Shanxi to Hebei. It is planned for commissioning in 2019.<ref>[http://www.escn.com.cn/news/show-487378.html "2018山西省重点工程名单：8个储能相关项目入围,"] 中国储能网新闻中心, 2018-1-2</ref>

Unit 1 was commissioned in March 2021.<ref>[http://sx.people.com.cn/n2/2021/0331/c189130-34649818.html "山西省首台百万千瓦发电机组顺利投产,"] 2021年03月31日</ref>
